phone.changelog: v3.6.0: DIRECT STREAMS — raw video plays in the app player (no ads, real seek, smooth buffering). Embed mirrors stay as fallback.

tv.changelog: v3.15.0: DIRECT STREAMS. The app now resolves raw video streams (1080p/720p/480p/2160p) before touching any embed page — plays in AJO's own player with no ads, real seek, smooth buffering. Embed mirrors remain as automatic fallback.
